# Soulsysta Collective

> Premium luxury sanctuary for psychotherapy, somatic healing, trauma recovery, and transformational guidance for women and youth. Founded by Merit Nene Chuks. Locations in London, Zurich, and global.

## What we do

- One-on-one therapy and coaching sessions
- Somatic healing and nervous system regulation
- Burnout recovery for executives and caregivers
- Youth mentorship (Youth Circle, ages 14-22)
- Community donations and the Soulsysta Initiative
- Books and educational content ("She Too Can." by Merit Nene Chuks)

## Featured services

- **Somatic Therapy** - body-based trauma release
- **Psychotherapy** - CBT, EMDR, integrative
- **Wellness Coaching** - burnout, executive recovery
- **Youth Mentorship** - confidence and leadership
- **Speaking Engagements** - corporate and event keynotes

## Read the journal

https://soulsysta.com/blog

Daily articles on therapy, somatic healing, generational patterns, burnout recovery, women's wellness, books, and youth empowerment.
